messages:
incident-bot: [PROBE ALERT] canary-probe embeddings-service-eu - 6/10 failures in last 5m. Severity: P2. Link: https://monitoring.redwood/alerts/1902345678

elena: saw this, grabbing dashboards now. looks noisy.

kevin: thanks. if it's noisy we should mute pager while we triage — low customer impact?

elena: muting pager for this rule for 30m while I investigate. no obvious customer errors in logs so far.

sre-bot: Pager muted for rule canary-probe:embeddings-service-eu by elena (reason: noisy synthetic checks)

matt: quick question — is this linked to the midnight rollout?

elena: possibly. I see a spike in cold-start latencies on workers that rolled last night. probes are sensitive to the cold path.

anya: ok if it's cold-cache noise we can tune the probe instead of disabling. propose: increase interval and relax latency threshold temporarily. also add a debounce so one window doesn't trigger a pager.

kevin: agree. concrete numbers?

elena: proposing changes:
```yaml
probe_id: embeddings-service-eu
old:
  frequency: 30s
  latency_threshold_ms: 200
  window: 1m
  alert_if_failures: 1
new:
  frequency: 120s # reduce noise, more representative
  latency_threshold_ms: 1000 # allow warmup spikes
  window: 5m
  alert_if_failures: 3 # require multiple failures before paging
  suppress_during_deploys: true
```

matt: that looks reasonable. also log the probe response sample to a short-lived blobstore for debugging if threshold breached.

elena: will push config change now and re-enable with new debounce.

sre-bot: updating probe config for embeddings-service-eu (change set: frequency 30->120s, threshold 200->1000ms, alert window 1m->5m, required failures 1->3)

elena: pushed and re-enabled. watching for next 3 probes (approx 6m).

kevin: can we add a temporary suppression rule that routes this alert to a logs-only channel and not to pager until we confirm?

elena: done — routed to #eng-oncall-debug for 30m.

matt: created lightweight dashboard card showing probe pass-rate (1h/6h/24h) and latency histogram. dashboard link: https://dashboards.redwood/probes/embeddings-service-eu

anya: please add an entry to the synth-probes runbook: include new suggested defaults for models with cold startups + example config.

kevin: I'll own the runbook PR. tagging in backlog: "synth: probe tuning - cold starts".

elena: current probe pass-rate climbed from 40% -> 92% after change. no customer-facing errors detected.

matt: nice. set follow-up action items:
- kevin: PR to runbook + testing checklist
- elena: confirm stable for 24h, roll back if new issues
- anya: add deploy suppression logic to monitoring infra

kevin: added GH issues: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/issues/4321

sre-bot: Note: we should also consider a longer-term fix — pre-warm cache / rolling staggered restarts after model updates.

elena: agreed, adding to infra backlog.

anya: let's have a 15-min sync tomorrow to review probe config defaults across regions.

matt: sounds good. leaving this thread as incident notes for the timeline. no customer impact and mitigated.

elena: handing off overnight watch to kevin. I'll be offline in ~30m. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
